title: MMC - My Movies Collection
desc: A full-stack entertainment aggregator and smart watchlist manager. Features multi-provider discovery (TMDB, AniList, TVmaze, WatchList, OMDB), custom-themed collections, watched history tracking, and shareable playlists with role-based access control.

title: indian-colleges-data-lib
desc: A web platform for exploring and filtering data across 23,000+ Indian higher education colleges.Built a multi-level hierarchical filtering system for fast, granular college discovery.Added data export to Excel and direct Google Maps location links.
